development.developer: Avant At Aljunied Pte Ltd (one-off SPV; no major-developer track record)
development.orientation_notes: Single boutique 8-storey infill block on a tiny ~907sqm plot fronting Aljunied Road (busy 4-lane arterial), ~330m north of Aljunied MRT (EW9), between Sims Avenue and Geylang Road. Road-fronting stacks take heavy traffic noise; the block sits amid Geylang shophouses/light-commercial frontage. Per-stack numbered facing NOT verified from text sources — needs a vision pass on the site plan. Known stack fact: stack 02, floors 2-5 (#02-02, #03-02, #04-02, #05-02) are the four 936sqft 2BR+Study DUAL-KEY units (two self-contained sub-units each). 700sqft 1BR+S units exist (largest 1+S type) — a low-psf 700sqft listing is plausibly a ground-floor/PES unit, not automatically a mis-scrape ($986psf 700sqft transacted Jun 2021).
known_issues: Effectively no facilities — EdgeProp lists '0 Facilities Available' on the 907sqm plot (marketing mentions a small pool); maintenance value proposition weak [EdgeProp]
Resident complaints: poor property management, pest issues, neighbourhood described as 'very dirty' [EdgeProp reviews]
Aljunied Road frontage = arterial traffic noise; Geylang-fringe surroundings carry owner-occupier stigma (address itself is Aljunied Rd, not a restricted lorong — bank financing normal)
Investor-dominated micro-unit mix (36/50 units are studio/1BR types ≤700sqft) — exit buyers are mostly other investors
Small-unit PSF still below its Jun 2018 peak of $1,826 as of 2026 ($1,572 Apr 2026) — long flat stretch despite headline 5yr CAGR
99-yr lease from 2012 — ~85yrs remaining, decay clock running
